# `sngl dump --format sngl` prints IR back as source, so what it prints has to
# be source. convertWindow built the node from Target, ID and the body alone and
# never read Title, Href, Favicon or ErrorHandler -- the props the IR does hold
# and html does emit -- so every one of them vanished from the dump.
#
# A routed href is the one that still does not print, and route.sngl is why. The
# checker desugars `"/u/{id}"` to a concatenation and synthesizes `id` as a
# window var, so a reprinted href would name `id` above the body that declares
# it. Reconstructing the template is the fix; until then the round trip is what
# is preserved, and the other props print either way.

sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl win.sngl
stdout 'window #home\('
stdout 'title="Hi"'
stdout 'href="/home"'
stdout 'favicon="f.ico"'
stdout '@error\(e error\)'

cp stdout out.sngl
sngl check out.sngl
stdout 'out.sngl: ok'

sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl route.sngl
stdout 'title="User"'
stdout 'var id string'
! grep 'href' stdout

cp stdout route_out.sngl
sngl check route_out.sngl
stdout 'route_out.sngl: ok'

-- win.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

window #home(title="Hi", href="/home", favicon="f.ico", @error(e) {
    output.print("{e.message}")
}) {
    text(value="hi")
}

-- route.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

window #user(title="User", href="/u/{id}") {
    text(value="user {id}")
}
